subject: Subscription health review — stage gates & finance checkpoint
messages:
From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Subscription health review — stage gates & finance checkpoint

Team —

Attaching the Q4 health summary and the commit matrix for EdgeCloud ahead of the Friday finance sweep. Quick context: this is a $420k ARR account (renewal window in 60 days). We have the standard support + Dedicated capacity add-on in play. Recent signal: a 30% drop in daily queries from their ML team and an exec note indicating pricing push from procurement.

Asking for two things before EOD Wednesday:
- Marcus: please update HubSpot Stage + probability (we currently have "Commit" at 65% — I want a sanity check vs usage signals).
- Laura: can you confirm whether we have any outstanding invoice credits or committed credits we promised in Q3? Finance would like the exact count (credits outstanding + credit memos).

Relevant risk indicators are flagged in the sheet (red = active churn signal). If the probability moves below 50%, we'll drop to "Watch" and initiate the churn playbook. If it remains >=65% we keep the current commit but add a contingency: a 30-day price-protection clause in the DocuSign envelope.

Attachments: EdgeCloud_subscription_health_Q4_summary.pdf, EdgeCloud_commit_matrix.xlsx

Thanks —
Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
phone: (415) 555-0134

From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Feb 2027 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Subscription health review — stage gates & finance checkpoint

Aisha —

Thanks for the note and the attachments. Quick update after I scrubbed the usage logs and recent touchpoints:
- Usage drop aligns with a paused ML initiative (internal at EdgeCloud). Their engineering PM confirmed the pause in a 02/09 sync.
- HubSpot: I changed Stage from "Commit" to "Late Commit" and adjusted probability to 55% (down from 65%). I left the close date unchanged (2027-04-12) but added notes referencing the paused project and the procurement pricing push.
- Action items I own: reach out to their ML lead to schedule a short technical health check; propose a one-week pilot with optimized batching to demonstrate 15% cost-savings.

Quote of my note in HS: "Paused project -> risk; recommend short technical pilot + finance concession if pilot returns target metrics."

I also uploaded an updated tab in the commit matrix highlighting the customer success (CS) touchpoints and the last support SLA deviation (1 incident last month).

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference

From: Helen Park <helen.park@edgecloud.com>
To: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: EdgeCloud Procurement <procurement@edgecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2027 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Subscription health review — stage gates & finance checkpoint

Aisha / Marcus —

Appreciate the proactive outreach. A few clarifying points from our side:
- The ML initiative is on hold pending an internal architecture review; we expect a decision by the end of March but cannot promise immediate resumption.
- Procurement is indeed exploring alternative vendors for a handful of non-core workloads, primarily to compare unit economics.
- Can you confirm whether the proposed one-week pilot would alter billing (i.e., additional usage charges) or if it can be scoped under our existing contract? Procurement prefers any pilot scoped as a limited, no-additional-cost trial if feasible.

We're open to the pilot if it can be structured as a proof-of-value without extra spend. Also, if Redwood can provide a temporary price-protection addendum while the pilot runs, that would make procurement more comfortable.

Best —
Helen Park
Head of Platform Partnerships | EdgeCloud
helen.park@edgecloud.com

From: Aisha Rahman <aisha.rahman@redwoodinference.com>
To: Helen Park <helen.park@edgecloud.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: EdgeCloud Procurement <procurement@edgecloud.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Feb 2027 17:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Subscription health review — stage gates & finance checkpoint

Helen —

Thanks for the clear ask. Confirming next steps and commitments:
1) Pilot scope: one-week pilot scoped to a specific batch workload; Redwood will not invoice for pilot usage if pilot targets are met (we'll treat it as a scoped trial under the existing contract).
2) Price-protection addendum: Finance has approved a 30-day price-protection clause for the pilot window (we'll add as an exhibit to the renewal envelope).
3) DocuSign: I'll send a small addendum to the existing renewal DocuSign link (related link above) that includes the pilot terms and the price-protection exhibit.
4) Internal: Marcus will run the technical call with EdgeCloud ML lead — Marcus, can you set a meeting for next week (available windows: Tue/Wed 9–11am PT)? Laura — can you confirm credit memos by EOD Friday so I can surface to Finance?

I'll follow up with the updated commit matrix and upload the addendum to HubSpot and DocuSign once the language is finalized. Appreciate the quick responses — this is a good example of the churn playbook working: transparent pilot + short-term protection to prevent premature vendor comparison.

Aisha
Aisha Rahman
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
